purpose: Teach: かもめ/持ち歩く/炊飯/日替わり/湿っ/ミニチュア/玉子/アテ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、海辺で、絶対、かもめ、絶対、撮影してきたわ
lines.en: Sho, I really did it — I got some amazing photos of seagulls down by the seaside.
lines.style: Bright, almost bursting with excitement. Warm laughter underneath. Quick rhythm with a satisfied landing on 'seaside.' Speaking like she can't wait to show him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、お守り、絶対、持ち歩く、絶対、いるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really do carry my favorite lucky charm with me everywhere, you know.
lines.style: Earnest, wanting her to understand something that matters to him. Quiet but certain. A small boy making a serious point, no performance in it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、炊飯、絶対、器、絶対、買ったのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I actually went ahead and bought a new rice cooker for myself.
lines.style: Animated, pleased with herself. Quick delivery with a little lift — she's sharing something she's proud of. Conversational, no pause to second-guess.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、日替わり、絶対、メニュー、絶対、ぼく、絶対、楽しみだよ
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to trying the daily specials at Mei-sis's place, you know?
lines.style: Genuine anticipation in the voice. Soft warmth — he's saying something he actually feels. No urgency, just honest interest. Like he's thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、洗濯物、絶対、雨で、絶対、湿って、絶対、しまったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Ugh, Sho — my laundry got all damp in the rain. So annoying.
lines.style: Wry, with gentle humor. A small sigh of exasperation underneath, but not complaining — more amused at her own bad luck. Quick, familiar tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ミニチュア、絶対、の家、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I actually made a miniature house together.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Slow enough that he's sharing something he made with his father. No bragging — just offering her something he's glad about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、玉子、絶対、料理、絶対、翔くんに、絶対、教えてあげるね
lines.en: I'll teach you how to cook eggs the right way, okay? It's important.
lines.style: Tender, offering a gift through teaching. Warm but patient — not hurried. The voice of someone who actually wants him to learn it well. Gentle landing at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、お酒の、絶対、アテ、絶対、おつまみ、絶対、上手だよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, you're really good at making snacks to go with Dad's sake, aren't you?
lines.style: Admiring, sincere. A small voice speaking to someone older, with genuine respect underneath. No flattery — just honest observation of something she does well.
